hints.title: Sort by Unit Density
hints.text: Sort box types in descending order of units per box to prioritize highest yield.

hints.title: Greedy Box Selection
hints.text: Take as many boxes of the current type as the remaining truck capacity allows.

hints.title: Update Remaining Capacity
hints.text: Deduct boxes chosen from truck capacity and stop when truck is full or boxes are exhausted.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is number of box types
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Knapsack DP is unnecessary because fractional choices are permitted at the unit level.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting takes O(n log n) time followed by a greedy linear sweep.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes fractional knapsack greedy structure.
